name: cognios
description: Connect Codex to a scoped CogniOS instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped CogniOS tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to CogniOS through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so CogniOS Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use CogniOS only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
